title: Runner Safety Tips
claims: Runners are advised to stay alert, trust their intuition and avoid a person or area that feels unsafe.
Varying routes and routines is recommended to reduce predictability.
Running against traffic and obeying traffic signals are listed as basic street-safety practices.
